budget_items.topic: FY17 Chapter 70 aid and required district contribution (Lunenburg)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY17 preliminary aid calculation shows Chapter 70 aid of 6,248,530, a required district contribution of 9,289,895, and an increase in aid over FY16 of 414,047.

budget_items.topic: FY16 Lunenburg foundation budget and required district contribution
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY16 slide shows foundation enrollment, the foundation budget, and the required contribution for the district.
Because foundation aid exceeds enrollment times the per-pupil increase, no minimum aid is awarded to Lunenburg.
budget_items.quote: since the foundation aid amount is greater than the foundation enrollment times $20. per pupil increase, no minimum aid is awarded

budget_items.topic: Trend in foundation budget, required contribution and Chapter 70 aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Foundation budget grew slightly, the required district contribution was almost level, and Chapter 70 aid rose slightly over the five-year trend.
budget_items.quote: there has been a slight growth in foundation budget, almost a level in the required district contribution and a slight increase in chapter 70 aid.

budget_items.topic: Statewide net school spending above foundation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Statewide actual net school spending exceeded the foundation budget by about 21% for FY16.
